The FloPlast 150mm x 150mm black gully grid is an essential component for effective external rainwater drainage. Constructed from robust polypropylene, this gully grid features a convenient downpipe knock-out section, allowing direct connection of a downpipe to an underground drainage system. The design offers broad compatibility with leading drainage brands, including Polypipe, Hepworth, Osma, Hunter, Marley, Brett, and Marshall Tufflex, making it a versatile choice for trade professionals undertaking drainage projects.
